cpu_preparation.scope: Ordered CPU-only process collation; RNG and sampling in main process. buffer.scope: 2 trainable ages; pre-commit disk peak includes unexpired old age and new-generation packing scratch. Mmap features; bounded minibatch transfers; no historical PPO admission.

split.scope: Outcome-independent hash ranking within table type; complete games excluded from all critic fits and caches; actor still uses these games. Rare strata oversampled in held-out diagnostics.
split.preparation_timing_scope: Host wall time; asynchronous device work may complete in the next section

beta_feedback.scope: Next phase only; a new hard-cap trip with 3/5 hits doubles beta. Clean accepted phases below half cap halve beta. No within-phase retries.

critic_rollout.scope: Fixed 1.00 snapshot critic loss weight; current ordinary learner holdout R2 is diagnostic only. GAE, economic and PPO/PPG guards unchanged.

warmup.scope: This iteration: retained PPG target fitting only. PPO preservation, rejected intervals and invalid/zero-weight targets excluded. Ramp changes after checkpoint commit.

local_scoring_auxiliary.training_scope: Detached device totals transferred together at reporting; attempted presentations/loss totals include rejected intervals. Retained counts follow joint checkpoint selection.
local_scoring_auxiliary.scope: Critic-train rows only; official held-out loss and exact policy KL remain the acceptance criteria. Invalid scoring audits fail admission.

value_preservation.scope: After PPO, before PPG. All critic-train rows for loss; nonforced learner PPO probe for four-seat utility RMS. True descriptors, no dropout; heldouts excluded from fitting. Core uses beta*value_weight; existing local-head weights are preserved separately.
value_preservation.actor_kl_scope: Unchanged raw-T1 PPO probe and separate behavior-policy guard; compare prior detach runs on the same recipe

opening_objective.scope: Eligible nonforced opening actions only, including post-fork openings. Detached capped old-T1/actual-behavior weights, no minibatch renormalization. Returns/GAE remain from the collected behavior trajectories.

branch_sample_usage.scope: Distinct branch continuation rows in retained PPO steps; branch move and prefix excluded

gae.scope: Raw pre-normalization nonforced learner decisions; critic targets remain Monte Carlo

historical.extension_age_scope: Committed collections using this lambda stage; qualification at lambda=1 does not count
historical.review: Inspect common PL rating slope/uncertainty and by-table advantage std; no automatic rollback

evidence.scope: Pooled row-weighted online EV at retained post-PPG weights; same contributing iterations for self-play; distinct whole-game support, learner seats only; not current-model re-evaluation or independent confidence bounds

historical.streak_scope: Consecutive PPO/economic health and applicable value KL guard; critic work supported across the mixed-table EV window

legacy.extension_age_scope: Committed collections using this lambda stage; qualification at lambda=1 does not count
legacy.review: Inspect common PL rating slope/uncertainty and by-table advantage std; no automatic rollback

evidence.scope: Pooled row-weighted online EV at retained post-PPG weights; same contributing iterations for self-play; distinct whole-game support, learner seats only; not current-model re-evaluation or independent confidence bounds

legacy.streak_scope: Consecutive PPO/economic health and applicable value KL guard; critic work supported across the mixed-table EV window

rating.scope: Latest common fit point-estimate slope; uncertainty remains, not proof of strength

stage_evidence.scope: Current lambda stage, committed rolling window; retained PPG critic work from healthy iterations only; zero steps alone do not reset health

gate.scope: Committed iterations only; no forks, extra ratings, or automatic rollback

health.scope: All-learner self-play: seat-weighted five-iteration VP, ordinary passes, zero-VP and insolvency rates. No IL action-probability checks; sales are reporting only.

anchor_gate.scope: Economic health only; AnchorKL measurement, calibration and gating disabled

training_health.scope: All-learner self-play: seat-weighted five-iteration VP, ordinary passes, zero-VP and insolvency rates. No IL action-probability checks; sales are reporting only.

gate.health_scope: Economic health and existing PPO/PPG evidence rules; AnchorKL measurement, calibration and gating disabled

critic_split.scope: Outcome-independent hash ranking within table type; complete games excluded from all critic fits and caches; actor still uses these games. Rare strata oversampled in held-out diagnostics.
critic_split.preparation_timing_scope: Host wall time; asynchronous device work may complete in the next section

sample_usage.scope: Actual PPO optimizer samples, excluding utility calibration, rehearsal and teacher distillation; presentations include epoch reuse

insolvency.scope: Ordinary trajectory statistics; branch continuation events separate, costs applied to every eligible row
insolvency.objective: Combined terminal utility minus future capped insolvency costs

distribution.scope: One complete-game observation per learner seat; population moments, not independent decisions

utility_calibration.reason: DCPG fresh targets are fitted only in the value phase

actor.baseline_scope: Before PPO, after any head calibration; nonforced learner decisions, in-sample

categorical_probe.kl_scope: categorical_kl is raw T1 movement and the LR signal. Raw T1 and actual-behavior exact KL each retain the PPO per-step cap. Opening-only KL is a diagnostic; sampled KL remains behavior-policy movement.
categorical_probe.scope: Exact KL(old raw T1 || new raw T1) plus separate behavior-policy KL on the proportional era/phase nonforced probe; PPO per-step early stopping and optional LR feedback

probe.scope: Immutable packed inputs and old probabilities; one PPO iteration, bounded, content checked

admission.scope: Content-checked selector admission within one Dataset

actor.kl_estimator: probe_categorical_kl/categorical_kl: exact KL(old raw T1 || current raw T1), per-step guard and LR signal; behavior_categorical_kl: independent exact behavior-policy guard at the same limit; post_update_kl/probe_kl: sampled behavior chosen-action ((ratio-1)-log(ratio)); diagnostics only, never a stop or LR signal. Behavior reconstruction is verified separately before updates.

cpu_preparation.scope: Ordered CPU-only process collation; RNG and sampling in main process. PPO uses private mapped staging; dense PPG reads sealed mmaps directly and uses at most one shared result slot per worker. Owned files/shared buffers are released before return. peak_output_bytes is a conservative bound, not process RSS.

health.scope: All-learner self-play: seat-weighted five-iteration VP, ordinary passes, zero-VP and insolvency rates. No IL action-probability checks; sales are reporting only.

lr_controller.scope: Exact post-PPO/pre-teaching KL; decision affects subsequent PPO steps only

final_categorical_probe.kl_scope: categorical_kl is raw T1 movement and the LR signal. Raw T1 and actual-behavior exact KL each retain the PPO per-step cap. Opening-only KL is a diagnostic; sampled KL remains behavior-policy movement.
final_categorical_probe.scope: Final checkpoint weights after PPO, value phase and any teaching; reference is collection behavior

search.reason: Teacher search and distillation disabled by configuration
